spans.s:
f. (-ङ्का)
1 The capital of RĀVAṆA in Ceylon; the name is extended also to the island, which according to the notions of the Hindus, is much more considerable in size, and lies further from the continent than in reality; it is described as being equal to 1/12th of the equatorial circumference of the earth, and is one of the places lying under the first meridian, [] whence the longitude is computed; it is thus placed in the Eastern ocean, South of Ceylon, and according to WILFORD is the peninsula of Malacca: according to some Hindu accounts also, it is distinct from Ceylon, from which island Laṅkā is said to be just visible.
2 A goddess or evil spirit, one of the Śākinīs, perhaps the same as the tutelar deity of the city of Laṅkā.
3 An unchaste woman.
4 A branch.
E.
लक to obtain (happiness, in which), aff. अच्, and नुग irr. augment.

m. (-ही)
The monkey HANUMĀN.
E.
लङ्का the city, and दाहिन् burner; having set fire to the city with his burning tail.

m. (-तिः)
RĀVAṆA the Daitya.
E.
लङ्का the city, and पति master, ruler; also लङ्काधिपति, &c.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
लक to taste, root of the 10th cl. aff. ण्वुल् fem. form, and नुम् augment; also य being changed to प, लङ्कापिका, and by a different derivation लङ्कोपिका.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Residing or being in Laṅkā.
m.
A plant.
(-नी)
(Euphorbia Tirucalli.)
E.
लङ्का Laṅkā or Ceylon, and स्थायिन् what abides or grows.

m. (-शः)
The Daitya RĀVAṆA.
E.
लङ्का the city Laṅkā, and ईश sovereign.

f. (-का)
A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
लङ्का Laṅkā or Ceylon, वप to sow or be sown, aff. क्वुन् fem. form, and the semivowel changed to its congener.

f. (-नी)
The bit of a bridle.

m. (-ङ्गः.)
1 Union, association, proximate connection.
2 A lecher, a catamite.
3 Limping, lameness.
E.
लगि to be near or with, &c., aff. अच्.

n. (-लं)
The tail of an animal.
E.
लगि to go, ऊलच् aff., more commonly लाङ्गूल.

n. (-लं)
A horse's tail.
E.
लगि to go, aff. उलच् see the next.

n. (-लं)
1 A hairy tail, (as a horse's, &c.)
2 The penis.
3 A granary, a basket or shed for holding corn or grain.
E.
लगि to go, Uṇādi aff. ऊलच्, and the radical vowel made long.

n. (-नं)
1 Fasting, abstinence.
2 Going, proceeding.
3 Leaping, springing, going by leaps or jumps.
4 Jumping over or beyond.
5 Exceeding, transgressing, disregarding propriety, going beyond proper bounds.
6 Storming a fort, entering by escalade, &c.
7 Capturing a fort in any way.
8 One of a horse's paces, curvetting, bounding.
E.
लघि to go, to fast, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be passed.
2 Transgressible.
3 To be fasted.
E.
लघि to go, अनीयर् aff.; also लङ्घ्य and लङ्घितव्य.

n. (-लं)
1 A plough.
2 The penis.
3 The palm tree.
4 A sort of flower.
5 The main beam of a house.
f. (-ली)
1 An aquatic shrub, (Jussieua repens.)
2 A creeping shrub, (Commelina salicifolia.)
3 Another creeper, (Nama repens.)
4 A plant, (Gloriosa superba.)
E.
लगि to go, to limp, &c., Uṇādi aff. कल, and the vowel made long.

m. (-हः)
A ploughman.
E.
लाङ्गल a plough, and ग्रह who takes.

n. (-णं)
Guiding the plough, ploughing.
E.
लाङ्गल, and ग्रहण taking.

m. (-ण्डः)
The pole or shaft of a plough.
E.
लाङ्गल a plough, and दण्ड a stick.

f. (-तिः)
A furrow.
E.
लाङ्गल a plough, and पद्धति a line.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to a plough.
m. (-कः)
One of thirty-four species of the fixed, or mineral and vegetable poisons.
f. (-का-की)
A small creeper, commonly Lāṅgalī, (Gloriosa superba); or, (Commelina salicifolia.)
E.
लाङ्गली a name of several plants, aff. कन्, fem. form, or लाङ्गल, and ठक् aff.

m. (-ली)
1 A name of

BALARĀMA.
2

The cocoanut tree.
3 A snake.
E.
लाङ्गल a plough, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Tailed.
m. (-ली)
A monkey.
E.
लाङ्गूल a tail, aff. इनि.
